Plaza for Windows

Plaza is a portable app: unzip this folder anywhere (Documents, Desktop) and double-click
Plaza.exe. Nothing is installed and no admin rights are needed. To remove it, delete the folder.

First launch: Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC". Plaza isn't code-signed
yet, so Windows doesn't recognise the publisher. Click "More info", check that the app is
Plaza.exe, then click "Run anyway". Windows remembers this for this copy.

Turn your volume down before the first note: long reverb tails and stacked chords get loud fast.

Keys: Z-M and Q-I play two octaves, [ ] or Left/Right change octave, Up/Down change preset,
Tab toggles slow + pitch down, Esc releases every note. USB MIDI keyboards connect by themselves.
Recordings (REC) go to your Music folder, in Music\Plaza. The music-note button opens it.

Command line (from PowerShell or cmd in this folder): .\Plaza.exe --help

Free and open source: https://github.com/nunyabiz765/plaza
From Center Point Labs: https://centerpointlabs.dev/services/plaza/
